text:
emma: FYI scheduling planned KV compaction in eu-west1 TOMORROW 02:00-03:00 UTC. We'll drain ~12% of serving nodes in that zone. Expected customer impact: short (5-20s) elevated tail latency on embeddings for some requests. Need: oncall handoff, statuspage copy, and customer email draft. Who's taking pager?

support_lead: taking initial handoff. I'll be oncall from 01:45-03:15 UTC to cover pre/post checks. @oncall-bot can you add a maintenance pager and set escalation to raj after 02:10 if errors spike? :thumbsup: 

oncall-bot: Pager created: maintenance-eu-west1-kv-compact. Run window 1761238200-1761241800. Escalation: support_lead -> raj. Reminder: run preflight checklist 30m before window. 

raj: quick note — enable canary routing to keep 2 healthy nodes serving embeddings during compaction, fallback to model-variant v1-small if latency > 2s. I'll watch model-serving metrics. 

sara: Status page draft below. Please copy/paste and approve. 

statusbot: 
```
Status: Maintenance (scheduled)
Component: Embedding service (eu-west1)
Start: 02:00 UTC
End: 03:00 UTC (estimated)
Impact: Short, intermittent elevated tail latency (5-20s) for some embedding requests. No data loss expected.
Customer guidance: We recommend delaying large batched embedding jobs until 03:15 UTC. Apps should automatically retry transient timeouts.
Updates: We'll post progress at start, 02:30, and completion.
```

emma: thanks — small edit to Customer guidance: add contact link for urgent issues (support@redwood.ai or pager). 

sara: updated email template (short): 

```
Subject: Planned maintenance - embedding service (eu-west1) — TOMORROW 02:00-03:00 UTC
Hi <customer>,
We're performing a planned maintenance window to compact key-value caches in eu-west1. During this time some embedding requests may see short (up to ~20s) increased latency. No data will be lost and requests will be retried by our clients. If you run large batched jobs, we recommend scheduling them after 03:15 UTC.
If this maintenance would cause severe disruption for you, reply to this email or open a support ticket and we'll coordinate.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

alice: approved from account side. Looks good to send. 

support_lead: I'll post the status page update at 01:55 UTC and send the customer email to affected accounts at 01:58 UTC. Oncall will escalate to raj if error rate > 3% above baseline for 5 minutes. 

oncall-bot: Preflight checklist reminder sent. 

statusbot: Progress update scheduled at 02:30 UTC. 

emma: Thanks all — please react :rocket: when you post so I can close the thread. 

support_lead: Posted status page and emailed customers. Reacted :rocket:. 

oncall-bot: Maintenance window completed. Post-maint validation shows 0.2% increase in 95p latency for embeddings, within expected range. Marking incident closed. 

emma: closing — great coordination, thanks everyone :clap:
